about_the_game:
WarSpawn is a multiplayer action PvP game inspired by old-school PvP classics such as Rakion Online and Infinity Online. Use teamwork to strategize and eliminate the enemy team's Elder God, or challenge yourself in the PvE Solo Survival mode. So come slash, stab, grab, blast, and launch your way to victory using various weapons with no timegates or pay-to-win, just dive right into the action and have fun!

  • Dynamic hack-n-slash combat: Out-maneuver your opponents with well timed movement abilities. Engage them with light and heavy attack combo sets unique to each weapon. And finish them off with special ranged attacks as they attempt to flee. The tools at your disposal provides fast-paced dynamic gameplay with a combat system that aims to be easy to learn, difficult to master, and always fun.

  • Team based PvP: Hop into the teamwork focused Elder Wars mode where two teams fight to expose and then takedown the opposing Elder God in epic multiplayer boss-fight sequences.

  • Step into a world inspired by the works of H. P. Lovecraft and the artworks of Moebius: A unique blend of Lovecraftian / Cosmic Horror, Moebius and Anime inspired aesthetics, and electronic soundscape creates a backdrop like none other for glorious PvP action.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later versions.
  • Processor: Intel or AMD Dual Core CPU
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10 Feature Level AMD or NVIDIA Card with 4GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later versions.
  • Processor: Intel or AMD 8 Core CPU
  • Graphics: DirectX 10 Feature Level AMD or NVIDIA Card with 8GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
